name: cashin-provider-refund
objective: Replace card-shaped provider coupling with a capability-driven Cash-In rail while preserving idempotency, unknown-result safety, authoritative finalization and source-aware refunds.
truthOwner: WLT payment/provider/refund domains; external providers supply evidence but never internal wallet truth.

tasks.objective: Introduce domain CashInRail, ProviderRegistry and deterministic FinancialRailRouter with explicit capabilities.
tasks.currentProblem: The current provider contract is transport-oriented and does not separate Cash-In capability from payout/inquiry assumptions.
tasks.requiredChange: Add domain rail interfaces/capability vocabulary and adapt mock/sandbox/production clients beneath them; configure one active provider without hard-coding a provider name into WLT product logic.
tasks.targetState: Cash-In routing is server-owned, capability-checked and configuration-driven; unknown capability fails closed.
tasks.action: Wrap existing provider clients with adapters, retain circuit-breaker/request metadata, and keep production adapter fail-closed until real contract evidence exists.
mustNotChange: Do not implement speculative real provider endpoints.
Do not add automated Cash-Out capability.
Do not remove mock/sandbox used by tests.
acceptanceCriteria: One active provider can be selected by configuration.
Production cannot select or fall back to mock/sandbox.
Capability mismatch rejects before external mutation.
tasks.rollback: Keep compatibility adapter until all payment callers are switched; roll back routing configuration without changing ledger history.

tasks.objective: Make customer and captain top-up authoritative purpose-driven Cash-In flows.
tasks.currentProblem: Payment sessions still use card authorize/capture paths and generic captured posting cannot safely distinguish top-up from checkout accounting.
tasks.requiredChange: Create top-up intent/session purpose, invoke CashInRail, verify/normalize provider evidence, and finalize once into the correct actor wallet through the canonical ledger.
tasks.targetState: Customer and captain Cash-In share one engine and differ only by trusted actor/purpose; duplicate/replayed evidence has one financial effect.
tasks.action: Reuse claim/idempotency/provider-result-unknown and authoritative finalization paths, replacing card-specific calls at the official-wallet edge.
mustNotChange: Do not credit from screenshots/client claims.
Do not trust caller amount/accounting destination.
Do not retry the same ambiguous movement through another provider.
acceptanceCriteria: Authoritative evidence is required before credit.
Replay is idempotent and conflicting replay is rejected.
Timeout/ambiguous result opens reconciliation and blocks a second mutation.
tasks.rollback: If external mutation semantics are uncertain, retain reconciliation-required state and never compensate by guessing success/failure.

tasks.objective: Align refunds and reversals with the original authoritative money source.
tasks.currentProblem: A generic refund path can incorrectly move value into internal balance when the original source was external or partially mixed.
tasks.requiredChange: Persist/resolve original source allocation and route full/partial refund through the supported authoritative source; otherwise fail closed into an explicit exception/manual reconciliation path.
tasks.targetState: Refund accounting conserves value and never changes source silently.
tasks.action: Extend refund policy/state and tests after PaymentAllocation/purpose are available; preserve current refund operator-context compatibility seam only where justified.
mustNotChange: Do not credit internal wallet as an implicit fallback.
Do not invent provider refund support.
Do not bypass idempotency for partial refunds.
acceptanceCriteria: Refund destination matches original governed source.
Unsupported external refund becomes explicit blocked/manual-reconciliation state.
Repeated refund request cannot exceed refundable allocation.
tasks.rollback: Preserve existing captured/ledger facts and use compensating entries; do not delete unresolved provider evidence.
